contents: Complete runnable working tree (git-ready). node_modules/dist/.git excluded; run npm ci to install.
corrective_scope: Responds to the independent audit findings F1-F10 against the Batch 10.4 deterministic packaging delivery. No Batch 10.5 work performed. No UI, clipboard, download, backup, restore, Prompt Pack, rendered-image, persistence-write, or external-integration work performed.

findings_addressed.F1: Reject backup/prompt_pack packaging scopes before any content or ZIP bytes are produced (existing EXPORT_SCOPE_001 code reused, no new error code).
findings_addressed.F2: Exact scope-to-file allowlists — every entry now derives from resolved scope content policy AND actually-selected artifacts; unconditional pair-file emission removed.
findings_addressed.F3: Independent semantic ZIP verifier — structural ZIP parsing plus checksums.sha256 and manifest.json content verification, all from the final bytes, never trusting the writer's own ledger alone.
findings_addressed.F4: Local/central directory header reconciliation and fixed-metadata enforcement (timestamp, compression method, general-purpose flag, external attributes, no data descriptor, no ZIP64, no symlink attributes).
findings_addressed.F5: Authoritative source fingerprints — plan.provenance (sessionFingerprint/sceneFingerprints/coverHash) computed from real source session/scene/cover data; removed the projectId-hash fallback.
findings_addressed.F6: Failure results after a valid plan now preserve plan.omissions and warning-severity plan.issues on every post-plan failure path.
findings_addressed.F7: src/export/index.ts now re-exports the approved packaging public surface; architecture tests updated transparently rather than relying on non-recursive exact-file-list blind spots.
findings_addressed.F8: This file, plus archiving of the stale Phase 7/9 root release metadata (see archived_release_metadata below) and a current per-file checksum listing (CHECKSUMS.txt).
findings_addressed.F9: Regular-file count and total ZIP-entry count are reported separately in the First Corrective completion report, not conflated.
findings_addressed.F10: createdAt is validated against real calendar semantics (leap years, days-in-month, hour/minute/second ranges), not just a text pattern, without reading the wall clock.
